title: phpdup configuration
description: Schema for phpdup.json. The phpdup CLI runs equivalent checks at load time via Phpdup\Cli\ConfigLoader::validate() and surfaces field-path errors before any analysis begins. Defaults below match Phpdup\Cli\Config.

paths.description: Source roots to scan. When this key is absent or empty, paths must come from the CLI args.

exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from the scan. ** matches recursively.

min_block_size.description: Minimum AST node count for a block to be considered. Must be <= max_block_size; the cross-field check is enforced at load time.

max_block_size.description: Maximum AST node count for a block. Must be >= min_block_size. Blocks above this are dropped before fingerprinting.

normalization_mode.description: strict = variable-rename tolerant only. default = also collapse literal values. aggressive = also collapse method, property, and class names.

similarity_threshold.description: Jaccard threshold for the near-duplicate clustering phase. Below this, the type-3 containment fallback may still apply when optional_blocks.enabled is true.

tree_threshold.description: APTED tree-edit-distance similarity threshold applied to candidates that passed the Jaccard filter.

min_cluster_impact.description: Minimum cluster impact (approximately the count of duplicated lines) required for a cluster to appear in the report. Quiets output without changing clustering.

max_df.description: Maximum document-frequency for an n-gram before it is treated as boilerplate and dropped from candidate-pair generation. 0.01 suits real codebases; bump to ~0.5 for tiny fixtures where every n-gram is 'common' by ratio.

candidate_budget.description: Safety cap on candidate pairs emitted during clustering. A pathological clone family halts with CandidateBudgetException instead of exhausting memory. 0 = unlimited (opts out of the guard). Default matches Clusterer::MAX_CANDIDATE_PAIRS.

ngram_size.description: Token-level n-gram length used for fingerprinting and Jaccard similarity.

fingerprint_id_mode.description: Identifier-numbering form of the similarity fingerprints (item 1.1, plan §5a). 'numbered' = legacy: the aggressive Normalizer's first-occurrence counters (__V3, __CALL12, __PROP0, __CLASS7) ride into the n-gram bag and the tree-edit labels, so one inserted guard renumbers every later identifier and breaks the fingerprint for the rest of the block. 'un-numbered' = strip the counters from bag tokens AND TED labels in lockstep (Phpdup\Util\IdentifierIds); multiset Jaccard, containment and TED similarity are monotone under this coarsening, so no edge accepted today is lost and guard-drift clones finally link. Structural hashes, anti-unification and ML pair features keep numbered input either way. ROOT CONFIG ONLY: a per-directory .phpdup.json carrying this key fails the load (mixed modes would poison the shared candidate index and warm caches). No CLI flag in v1. The mode value rides the worker tooling key, the per-file index cache key and the cluster-cache config key; 'numbered' keeps every cache and golden byte-identical.

max_ted_size.description: Node-count cap for APTED tree-edit judgment (item 1.2). A candidate pair whose LARGER member exceeds this cap skips the TED call entirely: it is accepted on Jaccard alone with edge tier 'jaccard-unverified' (weight = the Jaccard score), or falls through to the containment/IR/ML tiers unchanged — APTED is the O(n^2)-space quadratic cost site (161s / 1.2GB on a 1000-node pair). Default 800 equals the max_block_size extraction ceiling, so no real block can exceed it and the gate is inert out of the box: every existing verdict, cache and golden stays byte-identical. Lower it (e.g. 200-400) on giant-clone corpora to trade exactness for wall time. ROOT CONFIG ONLY: a per-directory .phpdup.json carrying this key fails the load — a pair spans two directories, so a per-directory cap would be ambiguous. No CLI flag in v1. The cap rides the cluster-cache config key and is applied identically by the serial Clusterer and the parallel PairScoreWorker.

max_hole_coverage.description: Hole-coverage ceiling for extraction honesty (item 5.4). Every cluster's generalized template is measured (hole_coverage = fraction of its AST units inside hole subtrees); a cluster whose coverage is STRICTLY ABOVE this threshold is marked re_expressed in the JSON and CLI reports, and its longest hole-free top-level statement run is surfaced as hole_fragment — the part actually worth extracting. Default 1.0 disables the rule (coverage can never exceed it), so every existing report and golden stays byte-identical. Lower it (e.g. 0.4, the plan's original draft figure) to flag hole-riddled abstractions — annotation never deletion: phpdup does not drop evidence based on a threshold. CLI: --max-hole-coverage. ROOT CONFIG ONLY: a per-directory .phpdup.json carrying this key fails the load — a cluster spans directories, and the threshold is a stance about the one final report.

cache_dir.description: Directory used for the AST cache and per-file index snapshots. The default is RELATIVE, so a normal run stores blobs inside the scanned tree; when that is the case phpdup refuses to read the cache unless you pass the CLI-only --trust-in-root-cache flag (engine-006: a committed cache in a cloned repo could be a planted decoy). Point cache_dir outside the tree (e.g. a shared temp dir) to keep reads trusted without the flag. CLI: --trust-in-root-cache (no config-file key; there is no 'trust_in_root_cache' setting here by design — the opt-in must be explicit per invocation).

parallelism.description: auto = detect CPU count and parallelize when worth it. off = run serially. manual = honor the workers field literally.

workers.description: Worker count for parallel preprocess + pair scoring. 0 = auto-detect from nproc / /proc/cpuinfo. 1 = serial. Higher is explicit.

incremental.description: Reuse per-file block snapshots from the IndexStore when the source hash, parser version, and config key all match. Disable for benchmarks or paranoid runs.

lazy_ast.description: Drop each block's original AST after fingerprinting; reload on demand inside the anti-unifier via BlockAstLoader. Disable for max speed when RAM is plentiful.

kinds.description: Block kinds to extract. Empty list (or omitted) means accept all twelve traversable kinds — the item-1.3 'script' kind (folds of top-level statements: requires, guards, bootstrap runs outside any function) is NEVER part of the implicit set and must be named explicitly. Script clusters are detection-only in v1: --apply and --refactor-patch refuse them (typed exit 1); text rendering (--patch/--diff) stays allowed. Equivalent to --kinds on the CLI.

sort.description: Cluster sort spec — KEY[:DIRECTION]. Keys: impact, members, block-size, lines, similarity, confidence, name, file, id. Aliases: size/count → members; block_size → block-size. Direction defaults to desc; a leading '-' forces desc, '+' forces asc. Equivalent to --sort on the CLI.

scope.description: Repo scope filter for reported clusters (item 5.1). 'all' = no filtering (legacy behaviour). 'single' = keep clusters whose members share one repo; 'multi' = keep clusters spanning >=2 distinct non-empty member repo labels; any other non-empty string = keep clusters with at least one member carrying that exact repo label. Repo labels are the basenames of the configured scan roots (each block's file matched against the longest root prefix), so a multi-repo analysis passes one root per repository. Applied after ranking: --limit/--sort and the CI gates all measure the filtered slice. CLI: --scope. Root-config/CLI only; a per-directory .phpdup.json carrying this key fails the load (report-level stance, chosen once per run).

score_mode.description: Scoring stance for cross-repo clones (item 5.1). 'global' = legacy math, byte-identical to every historical score, baseline and gate run. 'per-repo' = the >3-namespaces penalty in confidence (Ranker) and safety (SafetyScorer) is evaluated on the namespace spread within the densest member repo, so a subsystem mirrored across packages is no longer double-penalized for its mirroring (quantified: 13.2% of phlix clusters took the paired −0.05/−0.10 hit). 'typed' = audit posture: cross-repo clusters skip that penalty and instead gain +0.05 confidence / +0.10 safety — one shared helper erases N repo-local copies, so the spread is evidence FOR the refactor. Single-repo clusters score identically under every mode. CLI: --score-mode. Root-config/CLI only; a per-directory .phpdup.json carrying this key fails the load (report-level stance, chosen once per run).

optional_blocks.description: Tunables for type-3 / 'optional segment' clone detection — clusters where some members include extra statements not present in others, rendered as default-false bool $include* parameters in the suggested abstraction.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false the clusterer reverts to Jaccard-only and AntiUnifier falls back to whole-array subtree holes for divergent stmt arrays.

containment.description: ContainmentSimilarity threshold for the near-subset fallback used when Jaccard rejects a candidate pair. Higher = stricter.

min_overlap.description: Minimum size ratio (smaller bag mass / larger bag mass) for a near-subset pair to be kept. Prevents pairing a 1-line block with a 100-line one.

max_per_cluster.description: Cap on optional_block holes per cluster before AntiUnifier falls back to a single whole-array hole — guards against pathological seven-boolean signatures.

min_segment_length.description: Minimum stmt-array gap length (in raw stmts) to promote into an optional_block hole. Avoids noisy tiny mismatches.

report.description: File-output destinations. Equivalent to --html / --json on the CLI; the SARIF, GitLab SAST, diff, patch, and Checkstyle outputs are CLI-only.

html.description: Directory to write the interactive HTML report into.

json.description: Path to write the structured JSON report to.

db_aware.description: ORM-/DB-aware semantic deduplication (option 1 of docs/plans/orm-db-semantic-dedup.md). When true, the Normalizer runs DbOpCanonicalizer as a pre-pass: recognised database calls across Eloquent, Doctrine, query builders, PDO, mysqli, pg_*, and raw SQL strings rewrite to canonical __DB_<OP>__("table") tokens so equivalent ORM and raw-SQL variants of the same operation cluster together. Two honesty guards ride on it (engine-003): the generic verbs get/all/save fold only when the receiver chain carries DB evidence (builder table-literal seed, a recognised DB receiver/class name, or an informative user mapping), and SQL-promoted synthetics retain a coarse payload signature — the sorted column set as a structural __DB_COLS_<set> name argument — so same table+verb payloads touching different columns cluster as near-duplicates instead of exact clones. Off by default — enabling it broadens clustering but raises the false-positive ceiling, so it's an explicit opt-in. CLI: --db-aware.

trinity_collapse.description: Trinity-collapse (option 2 of docs/plans/orm-db-semantic-dedup.md). When true, the Normalizer runs TrinityCollapser as a pre-pass that detects the canonical CRUD trinity (read → mutate → save) and rewrites the three-statement sequence as a single __DB_UPSERT__("entity") synthetic call. Composes with db_aware. Off by default. CLI: --trinity-collapse.

scorer.description: Scoring tier set (option 5 of docs/plans/orm-db-semantic-dedup.md — clusterer wiring). 'default' = stock AST-tier scoring (Jaccard + TED + containment). 'ir' = also enable the IR-tier fallback after AST tiers reject: lift both blocks to canonical IR (Phpdup\Ir\IrLifter) and Jaccard their token bags. Pairs at or above ir_threshold form edges. CLI: --scorer.

ir_threshold.description: Multiset-Jaccard threshold for the option-5 IR tier. Only consulted when scorer=ir. CLI: --ir-threshold.

ml_pair_url.description: External pair-similarity ML sidecar URL (option 6 of docs/plans/orm-db-semantic-dedup.md — clusterer wiring). Empty (the default) disables the tier. When set, the very last clustering tier — POSTs a PairFeatures vector to <URL>/score-pair; pairs at or above ml_pair_threshold form edges. http(s) only; SSRF-hardened (rejects file:// / gopher:// / 0.0.0.0). Returns null on transport failure so unavailability never breaks the run. CLI: --ml-pair-url.

ml_pair_threshold.description: Similarity threshold for the option-6 ML pair tier. Only consulted when ml_pair_url is set. CLI: --ml-pair-threshold.

db_symbols.description: User-extensible DB symbol equivalence registry (option 4 of docs/plans/orm-db-semantic-dedup.md). Custom method/function name → canonical-op mappings merged on top of the stock DbOpRegistry entries. Keys are matched case-insensitively (both stored keys and looked-up call names are lower-cased), so the lower-case convention and camelCase pack keys both work; values are one of db.read | db.write | db.delete | db.execute | db.query. Profiles ship symbol packs (db-aware-laravel, db-aware-doctrine, db-aware-cake) that can be loaded via --profile.

methods.description: Method-name → canonical-op map. Matches against StaticCall, MethodCall, and NullsafeMethodCall names regardless of receiver; name matching is case-insensitive (camelCase keys fold to the same entry as lower-case). Exempt from the receiver-evidence gate only when the mapped op differs from the stock classification of a generic tier name (get/all/save) — a verbatim re-statement keeps the gate (engine-003).

functions.description: Function-name → canonical-op map. Matches against FuncCall names; name matching is case-insensitive (camelCase keys fold to the same entry as lower-case). Not subject to the receiver-evidence gate.

low_memory.description: Reduce memory footprint: use CompactNgramBag (32-bit fingerprint) and CanonicalNodePool interning. CLI: --low-memory.

fail_on_impact.description: CI gate: exit code 3 when total cluster impact exceeds this value. 0 = disabled. CLI: --fail-on-impact.

max_clusters.description: CI gate: exit code 3 when cluster count exceeds this value. 0 = disabled. CLI: --max-clusters.

baseline.description: CI baseline file for incremental duplication gating. If file exists: load baseline and exit 4 if new clusters are found (clusters whose member content hashes are not all present in some baseline cluster). If file does not exist: write baseline snapshot and exit 0 (first-run auto-baseline). CLI: --baseline. ROOT CONFIG ONLY: a per-directory .phpdup.json carrying this key fails the load — it names a file the run reads and writes, so no scanned subtree may choose it (shell-S22).

baseline_out.description: Write current clusters as a baseline snapshot to FILE (overwrites existing). Useful for explicitly creating or updating baselines. CLI: --baseline-out. ROOT CONFIG ONLY: a per-directory .phpdup.json carrying this key fails the load — it names a file phpdup OVERWRITES, so no scanned subtree may choose it (shell-S22).

diff_base.description: Git ref for diff-scoped analysis. When set, phpdup scans only files changed in `git diff --name-only <ref>..HEAD` plus their clone cohort (files sharing n-gram fingerprints with the changed files). Useful for per-PR analysis in CI. CLI: --diff-base. ROOT CONFIG ONLY: a per-directory .phpdup.json carrying this key fails the load — the ref becomes argv of an external git call, so no scanned subtree may choose it (shell-S22; argv confinement of the ref itself lands shell-S23/output-S52).
